title: Individuals With the Most Grammy Nominations: Full List
summary: Beyoncé leads, but who else is on the list?
contentText:
When the nominations for the 69th annual Grammy Awards were announced on Monday (Nov. 16), Beyoncé became the first individual to amass 100 Grammy nominations. That milestone prompted us to take a fresh look at the most-nominated individuals in Grammy history.

Beyoncé received her first two Grammy nominations at the 2000 ceremony for Destiny’s Child’s hit “Bills, Bills, Bills.” The smash, which was the group’s first No. 1 hit on the Billboard Hot 100, was nominated for best rhythm & blues song and best R&B performance by a duo or group with vocal. In 2023, Bey surpassed the late classical conductor Georg Solti to become the individual with the most Grammy wins in history. (Solti landed his final two Grammy nods in 1999, the year before Bey received her first. He was honored posthumously for his album Georg Solti – The Last Recording .)

Not all of these individuals did as well translating nominations into wins. Drake has received 57 nominations but has won just five Grammys – all in rap categories. He’s the only artist on this list of most-nominated individuals who has won fewer than 10 Grammys.

Here are the 18 individuals with the most Grammy nominations. We show their total number of Grammy nods to date; the span of years from the first Grammy ceremony where they were nominated to the most recent; and their total number of wins to date. I also identify any wins in the closely-watched “General Field” categories – album, record and song of the year; best new artist; and producer and songwriter of the year, non-classical.
